about_the_game:
This is a casual game, players can choose a person carefree, can also choose to form a camp, find a variety of resources, set up their own expedition, across the boundaries of life and death, whether it is the world of life, or the world of death, players have to start from the beginning, when the player in the world of death to the world of life will lose the assets of the dead world, and vice versa. Assets this thing is not born, death naturally can not take away. Between life and death we all come naked, full of refuse to leave,

The game character shown so far is not meant to be the main character, but is definitely one of the resources that will be used in the game

This game includes: production, combat, and interaction with objects in the scene. Since the game is under development, I will broadcast live on bilibili at least 3 days a week. I will update the announcement video on 10th Beijing time every month until the game development is completed.

  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600k | AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon RX 590
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

  • OS: WINDOWS® 10,11 (64-BIT Required)
